retrievalProfile.description: Generates a square-format instant film portrait featuring a subject in the foreground and a vintage cinema marquee with physical plastic lettering in the background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format photograph with a white instant-film border, featuring a man in sunglasses in the lower right foreground and a large, angled cinema marquee with red plastic letters in the upper left background, characterized by warm, faded, and slightly yellowed analog tones.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in lower right foreground looking away from camera
Large marquee sign dominating the upper left quadrant
Strong diagonal perspective from the sign leading toward the subject
Heavy shadow under the marquee creating a dark void behind the subject
coreInvariants: White instant-film border with chemical staining at the bottom edge
Warm, desaturated color palette with yellow-green highlights
Physical plastic marquee lettering with visible mounting tracks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-close, positioned in the bottom right third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, white marquee sign in the upper left acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the marquee from top-left down to the subject in the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space created by the shadow under the marquee overhang.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (shadows and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed dynamic range; highlights are yellowed and blacks are slightly lifted.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear slightly misaligned as if placed by hand on a track
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the condensed, blocky feel of vintage signage.
Provides the utilitarian look of plastic marquee letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square polaroid-style photo of a man with a beard and sunglasses in the lower right, with a large vintage cinema marquee sign in the upper left. The sign should have empty horizontal tracks. Use a warm, faded 1970s film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add red, condensed, sans-serif plastic-style lettering to the marquee tracks, ensuring the perspective matches the angle of the sign.

verificationChecks: Is the frame square with a white border?
Are the colors warm and faded like old film?
Is the text integrated into the marquee tracks?
Is there a heavy shadow under the sign?

mustAchieve: Consistent perspective between sign and text
avoid: Perfectly horizontal text on an angled sign

postGenerationChecks: Check for chemical staining on the bottom border
Ensure the subject is looking away from the camera
Verify the marquee letters look like physical objects
Confirm the color palette is yellow-tinted
recipe.reuseFormula: Square Polaroid Frame + Angled Cinema Marquee + Faded Warm Tones + Condensed Red Plastic Lettering
